                    ### Question
                    Which of the following antitussive can lead to hallucinations

                    ### Options
                    opa. Morphine
opb. Dextromethorphan

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Dextromethorphan, an antitussive that acts on the central nervous system, can cause dissociative effects including hallucinations, especially at high doses. Diphenhydramine, with anticholinergic properties, can also lead to hallucinations at high doses but less commonly compared to dextromethorphan. Morphine and aprepitant do not commonly cause hallucinations, with morphine primarily inducing euphoria and pain relief, and aprepitant being used to prevent nausea without known hallucinogenic side effects.
